questions.q: In "Reading short texts Remember", which of these is a key idea?
o: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Writing short texts' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Use it: write about me, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
Use it: give a short talk, first with help, then alone.
